date_note: Date Bitdefender published its research; the page gives no earlier day.
title: Bitdefender: SYS010 campaign uses Meta ads for free animated-wallpaper apps to target Meta Business users
summary: Bitdefender Labs says SYS010, which it calls the second major version of the SYS01 campaign, uses Meta ads promoting free animated wallpaper apps for Windows. It says victims get a working wallpaper app that also installs malicious components, which can steal cookies, collect Facebook ad-account data and read recent Gmail and Outlook web messages. Bitdefender says it targets Meta Business users.
plain: Bitdefender says ads on Meta for free animated wallpapers install hidden malware that targets people who manage business ad accounts.
exec: Bitdefender says stolen Meta ad accounts can be used to run paid malicious ads under a trusted business identity.
action: Bitdefender advises never downloading software from a social-media ad, cancelling repeated administrator prompts, limiting Meta admin access and protecting business email with a unique password and multi-factor authentication.

validation.note: Bitdefender Labs' own research post read; ifeng.com (27 November, a repost of IT Home) restates it. The ifeng page names the apps Lively Wallpapers and Wallpaper Engine; the Bitdefender page names Wallpaper Engine and Live Wallpapers.
